map.由资产与负债求净资产: Net Worth from Assets and Liabilities
map.输入总资产与总负债，求净资产。: Enter total assets and total liabilities to find net worth.
map.📖 查看「由资产与负债求净资产 使用指南」: View "Net Worth from Assets and Liabilities User Guide"
map.净资产=总资产−总负债，含房产、存款、投资与房贷、信用贷等。自住房计入资产但流动: Net worth = total assets − total liabilities, including property, deposits, investments and mortgage, credit loans, etc. The own home counts as an asset but is illiquid; when analyzing solvency, 'investable net worth' is often listed separately.
map.家庭财务盘点时核算真实财富水位。: Tally the true wealth level when taking stock of household finances.
map.申请大额授信时证明资产实力。: Demonstrate asset strength when applying for large credit facilities.
map.净资产=总资产−总负债=500−200=300 万。若含自住房但负债多为房贷，需: Net worth = total assets − total liabilities = 500 − 200 = 300 (ten-thousand). If the own home is included but liabilities are mostly mortgage, distinguish 'net worth' from 'investable net worth'.
map.自住房算资产吗？: Does the own home count as an asset?
map.算。净资产=所有资产（含房产、存款、投资）减所有负债（房贷、车贷、信用贷）。但自: Yes. Net worth = all assets (property, deposits, investments) minus all liabilities (mortgage, auto loan, credit loan). But the own home is illiquid, so 'investable net worth' is often listed separately when analyzing solvency.
map.能。当负债超过资产（如房价大跌且高杠杆）即为负净资产，俗称「资不抵债」，需警惕流: Yes. When liabilities exceed assets (e.g. a sharp price drop with high leverage) net worth is negative — colloquially 'insolvent' — so watch liquidity and default risk.
